subject: R shiny deployment error in building BiocGenerics package

messages.author: 7a82b861c9ef9967
messages.subject: R shiny deployment error in building BiocGenerics package
parts:
Hello,

I am getting the below error while trying to deploy a rather simple Shiny app-

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 280439...DONE
Deploying bundle: 1220853 for application: 280439 ...
Waiting for task: 509141091
  building: Processing bundle: 1220853
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 1227303
  error: Building package: BiocGenerics
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 509141092 failed: Error building image: Error fetching BiocGenerics (0.23.0) source. Error downloading package source. Please update your BioConductor packages to the latest version and try again: <BioconductorPackageSource
Execution halted


sessionInfo()
R version 3.4.3 (2017-11-30)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows >= 8 x64 (build 9200)

Matrix products: default

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252  LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] rsconnect_0.8.5 shiny_1.0.5    

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] compiler_3.4.3       R6_2.2.2             BiocInstaller_1.26.1 htmltools_0.3.6     
 [5] tools_3.4.3          RCurl_1.95-4.10      Rcpp_0.12.15         RJSONIO_1.3-0       
 [9] digest_0.6.15        xtable_1.8-2         httpuv_1.3.5         packrat_0.4.8-1     
[13] mime_0.5             bitops_1.0-6

I realize this error has occurred to users before and I think it somehow got fixed by a R version downgrade. However, I tried deploying using R version 3.2.4 but wasn't successful. Any help in this regard would be highly appreciated.
Many thanks in advance!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: R shiny deployment error in building BiocGenerics package
